issues.on_page: Miscellaneous 484,264 (General 198,944 'Other, including local grants' p7; Special Projects 24,803; LB840 260,517)
issues.issue: The Statement of Activities (p2) shows 'Grants and contributions not restricted to specific programs 199,404', and the General Fund part is labelled 'Other, including local grants'. So at least the General Fund 198,944 may be donations/contributions rather than other. Keeping it in other with review is defensible. Same applies to detail[16].

Loan repayments (Facade Improvement 5,344 and Special Projects 979: repayments of loans the city made) are placed in other. No listed category fits cleanly, so this is a judgment call. Same for detail[103] and detail[115].
The label mixes sales tax with miscellaneous taxes, but the line has no review note. The p4 statement does show this amount inside 'Sales taxes', so sales tax is the dominant category.
